newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Leighton rules out buyout of Hochtief stake.
newsitem.headline: Leighton rules out buyout of Hochtief stake.

text.p: Construction group Leighton Holdings Ltd ruled out on Sunday using its cash pile of over A$400 million to buy out the 44.9 percent stake in Leighton held by German construction group Hochtief AG.

"No, I don't believe that is any sort of practical alternative," Leighton Chief Executive Wal King told the Nine Network's Business Sunday television programme when asked if Leighton would buy out its controlling shareholder.
"We have a long-term partnership with our German colleagues and it will continue in that direction," King said.
Leighton announced annual results on Thursday showing it had no debt and available cash of A$422.88 million.
King announced a strategic review to decide how to deal with the cash pile, raising the possibility of new acquisitions and playing down the prospect of a capital return.
